extracted.intended_audience: journalists, journalism students, editors and news organizations interested in producing investigative and data-driven digital journalism
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on producing high-quality, sustainable investigative journalism using data, digital tools, collaboration, audience engagement, and strong ethical standards. Emphasizes resource needs, methods for turning data into human stories, and organizational practices that multiply impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify information and demonstrate high ethical standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Given all the trash, half-truths and outright lies published on digital media, people are placing a higher value on media that verify information and demonstrate high ethical standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report must be verified and fair even when it angers powerful sources or donors (example: ProPublica told a donor their story was verified and fair and accepted losing funding). High standards of accuracy and ethics build long-term respect and credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration to multiply impact
rubrics_metrics.description: A small team can multiply its impact by collaboration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work with other outlets and partners to extend reach — ProPublica's model shows a focused team of 50 journalists can have outsized impact by sharing and collaborating across platforms and organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open licensing and wide syndication (Steal Our Stories / Creative Commons)
rubrics_metrics.description: ProPublica has shared its investigative reports under Creative Commons license with more than 100 print, television and radio media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Syndicate or license work openly to increase distribution and influence (examples: BBC, NYT, Washington Post, NPR, PBS). Sharing can amplify impact beyond the originating organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data-driven reporting and building searchable databases
rubrics_metrics.description: Their stories are increasingly data-driven. With nine data journalists, they have produced stories and searchable databases revealing patterns across large datasets (e.g., rates of medical complications for 17,000 surgeons; Dollars for Docs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invest in data journalists and infrastructure to analyze, visualize, and publish datasets that support reporting and enable public use. Use data to reveal systemic patterns rather than isolated anecdotes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use digital tools to effect change
rubrics_metrics.description: ProPublica has made great use of digital tools to get laws changed, halt predatory lending practices and expose financial fraud on a national scale.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverage digital platforms, visualization, and online distribution strategically to drive policy change and public accountability, not just to tell stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Make investigative journalism social and audience-engaged
rubrics_metrics.description: Investigative journalism is social: for their series on surgeons, reporters created a forum where patients could share their stories and exchange experiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Build forums, social media presence, and mailing lists to engage sources, affected communities, and readers; audience engagement both sources reporting and demonstrates loyal followership (example metrics: followers, fans, subscribers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Expect and budget for high cost and long timeframes
rubrics_metrics.description: Investigative journalism is expensive and time-consuming. A ProPublica investigation typically costs from US$200,000 to US$500,000; the investigation of surgeons took three years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan realistic budgets and timelines; complex investigations require sustained resources to ensure thoroughness and defensibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation must be fair, complete and bullet-proof
rubrics_metrics.description: Need to make the presentation as fair, complete and bullet-proof as possible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allocate time for verification, legal review, and rigorous editing; thoroughness protects credibility and helps withstand scrutiny, challenges, or litigation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transform data into human stories (combine data with shoe‑leather reporting)
rubrics_metrics.description: "The data is the starting point. You then have to do the shoe‑leather reporting to find the human story in the statistics."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use data analysis to identify leads, then pursue interviews, documents and on-the-ground reporting to surface human narratives that make data meaningful and persuasive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hard work and perseverance as primary qualities of reporters
rubrics_metrics.description: "You need both [talent and hard work], but what makes a good journalist, more than anything, is hard work and perseverance."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize persistence, thoroughness and tenacity in reporting work; training and talent help, but sustained effort drives investigative outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pay interns and treat early-career reporters ethically
rubrics_metrics.description: "The only ethical way to treat interns was to pay them. If you don't, you are creating a pernicious two-tiered system that favors students from well-to-do families..."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compensate interns to broaden access and avoid excluding those who cannot afford unpaid work; ethical staffing practices support diversity and fairness in the newsroom.

rubrics_metrics.name: Build a financially sustainable, agile newsroom model
rubrics_metrics.description: Despite the crisis that traditional journalism is suffering, there is another way to do high-quality journalism, which is digital, multimedia, collaborative, data-driven, agile, and from a business perspective, it is sustainable financially.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design organizational and business practices (small focused teams, diversified funding, digital-first production, syndication) that allow investigative work to be produced repeatedly without unsustainable costs.
